render.note: 逻辑地图、metatile、属性、场景 palette 与 header 扩展记录指定的四个场景阶段 CHR-ROM bank 独立合成。

transition_coordinate_semantics.destination_x_y: actual landing cell stored in ROM
transition_coordinate_semantics.camera_origin_x_y: runtime camera origin after subtracting anchor (8,7)

treasures.investigation_resolution_detail: $BD9C writes metatile $01 for an uncollected row and $02 after collection; behavior $64 then calls $BE3E to match the same coordinate row

runtime_metatile_overlay.writeback: runtime SRAM map only; ROM map stream is unchanged

metatile_investigation_points.label: 场景专用调查物
metatile_investigation_points.description: 按场景或地图数据分流到招牌、衣橱、农田、裂缝等专用文字/动作。

interaction_state.label: 状态由场景专用处理器决定

metatile_investigation_points.activation: current cell first, then the cell in front; the six special points precede metatile dispatch; treasure rows resolve before dispatch only in scene $00/$81/$E0-$EF, otherwise through runtime behavior $64

zone.entries_readonly_reason: zone $00 从不抽取，且其候选行与场景 zone 表尾部（场景 $80-$EF）共用同一批物理字节

writeback.editable: existing actor fields, treasure rows, investigation points and transition targets; world-event rows are a read-only projection owned by world-event
